As a member of the UC Irvine Police Department, the Public Safety Responder assists in monitoring, observing, and reporting public safety concerns and conditions. The essential functions listed below are not intended to be an exhaustive list of all duties that may be assigned to this position, nor does it restrict duties that may be assigned to this position if such duties are reasonably related to the position.
Must be able to conduct sustained foot patrols and/or extended stationary (standing/sitting) post assignments.
Completion of PC 832 Arrest and Firearms training
As a condition of employment, must successfully complete an extensive background investigation, including Livescan fingerprinting, and a medical examination.
No Felony convictions.
Must be able to work shift work, including day and night shifts, weekends, and holidays.
Must complete the UC Irvine Police Department Public Safety Field Training program.
Must be able to learn Orange County Communications radio codes and operate a two-way radio.
Must be able to wear and operate in Personal Protective Equipment (PPE).
Must complete and pass a background investigation, Livescan, and medical examination.
The ability to read, write, and speak proper English.
Ability to work variable shifts, including evenings, nights, weekends, and holidays
Knowledge of and ability to display/use exceptional customer service and communication skills.
Must possess the ability to operate a vehicle, radio, taser, handcuffs, first aid equipment and other related equipment as assigned.
Ability to effectively operate video surveillance equipment once trained.
